detect.command:
count=0
pm=""
html=0
if find . -name '*.html' ! -path './node_modules/*' ! -path './.git/*' -print -quit | grep -q .; then
  html=1
fi
if [ "$html" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: seo-performance unavailable, no html files in the tree" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json is required to provision html lint tooling" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
printf '%s\n' "$pm"

enabledShifts.fallback: audit owner-supplied local files only; cite file sizes and html lint findings from the tree without lab timings when performance tooling is unavailable

maintenance.check: lastVerified older than 180 days, or the pinned htmlhint range no longer resolves in the lockfile's manager

packageManagerAdditions.command:
count=0
pm=""
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=npm; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=pnpm; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then count=$((count + 1)); pm=yarn; fi
if [ "$count" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "nightshift: $count lockfiles present, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
  exit 78
fi
declared="$(sed -n 's/.*"packageManager"[^"]*"//p' package.json | cut -d@ -f1 | head -n 1)"
if [ -n "$declared" ] && [ "$declared" != "$pm" ]; then
  echo "nightshift: package.json names $declared, the lockfile names $pm" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if ! find . -name '*.html' ! -path './node_modules/*' ! -path './.git/*' -print -quit | grep -q .; then
  echo "nightshift: seo-performance unavailable, no html files in the tree" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f .htmlhintrc ] && grep -q '"htmlhint"' package.json; then
  echo "nightshift: htmlhint is already configured here; the repository tooling wins" >&2
  exit 78
fi
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm install --save-dev "htmlhint@^1.1.4" "serve@^14.0.0"; fi
if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm add --save-dev "htmlhint@^1.1.4" "serve@^14.0.0"; fi
if [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn add --dev "htmlhint@^1.1.4" "serve@^14.0.0"; fi

permissionRequirements: receipt: evidence lines only — file byte sizes, local fetch timings, and html lint rule ids; never rankings, traffic, field data, or strategy

probe.command:
if [ ! -f .htmlhintrc ]; then exit 1; fi
if grep -qE '"htmlhint"[[:space:]]*:' package.json; then exit 0; fi
if [ -d node_modules/htmlhint ]; then exit 0; fi
exit 1

rollback.command:
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm uninstall htmlhint serve
elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm remove htmlhint serve
elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn remove htmlhint serve
fi

smoke.command:
set -u
run_pm() {
  if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm exec --no -- "$@"
  elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm exec "$@"
  elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then yarn run "$@"
  else
    echo "nightshift: no lockfile, the package manager is not decidable" >&2
    exit 78
  fi
}
find . -type f \( -name '*.html' -o -name '*.css' -o -name '*.js' \) ! -path './node_modules/*' ! -path './.git/*' -print0 |
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    bytes=$(wc -c <"$f" | tr -d ' ')
    printf 'evidence: file-size %s %s bytes\n' "$bytes" "$f"
  done
run_pm htmlhint '**/*.html'
rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -gt 1 ]; then exit "$rc"; fi
port=3456
while command -v nc >/dev/null 2>&1 && nc -z 127.0.0.1 "$port" 2>/dev/null; do port=$((port + 1)); done
run_pm serve -l "$port" . >/dev/null 2>&1 &
pid=$!
trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
sleep 1
for page in index.html about.html; do
  if [ -f "$page" ]; then
    curl -o /dev/null -s -w 'evidence: local-timing %s %{time_total}s\n' "http://127.0.0.1:$port/$page" || exit 1
  fi
done
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
